response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM transaction_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_average ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES
